gapSummary: Convention-based implementation discovery through IInstancesOf<T> and the [Singleton]/[Scoped] lifetime conventions, verified against Cratis.Fundamentals 7.18.2. It is a profile of its own rather than a second target on public-fundamentals because that profile is the selected passive-preview package, whose authority pins it to exactly one target. Serialization and the remaining Fundamentals primitives are gaps.
